name: SW2_WeaponPoseFrames
formula: replace 15B (subss xmm0,xmm6; comiss xmm0,xmm7; movss [rbx+0x436C],xmm0): subss xmm0,[e]; comiss xmm0,xmm7; movss [rbx+0x436C],xmm0; jmp insn+15 (the ja 0x1405F7677; flags from comiss preserved). xmm6 must stay 1.0 (reused as w=1 at 0x1405F76E6) so the constant cannot be redirected

name: SW2_LightTransitionGate
formula: gate: execute call only when ticks60 > 0 (140789e20 = frame-stepped light/env param transition: params += precomputed per-frame step, frame counter [0x8E480] -= 1; void, no other outputs)

name: SW2_BossGaugeSmoothA
formula: replace 8B (addss xmm0,[rdi+0x98]; xmm0=t from vcall [rdx+0x100]): mulss xmm0,[k_bg_l] ; k_bg_l = lerp 0.5 = 1-0.5^e | movss xmm1,[rdi+0x98] | mulss xmm1,[k_bg_p] ; k_bg_p = pow 0.5 | addss xmm0,xmm1 | jmp 0x1408B0207 (the store; skips the shared mulss 0.5). Bit-exact at e=1 since t*0.5+v*0.5 == (t+v)*0.5. xmm1 dead, flags dead

name: SW2_BossGaugeSmoothB
formula: replace 8B (movss xmm0,[rdi+0x98]; no-target branch): movss xmm0,[rdi+0x98] | mulss xmm0,[k_bg_p] ; pow 0.5 | jmp 0x1408B0207 (store). flags dead

name: SW2_CoreMenuCtrA
formula: 30-frame wait [rdi+0x294] (set to 0x1E). replace 6B (dec dword [rdi+0x294]): push rax; mov eax,[ticks60]; sub [rdi+0x294],eax; pop rax; jmp insn+6. flags dead (cmp [rdi+0x294],0 follows); all regs preserved

name: SW2_CoreMenuCtrB
formula: 8-frame wait [rdi+0x294]. replace 7B (sub dword [rdi+0x294],1): push rax; mov eax,[ticks60]; sub [rdi+0x294],eax; pop rax; jmp insn+7. flags LIVE (jne uses ZF of the sub; push/pop/jmp keep them); all regs preserved

name: SW2_CoreMenuCtrC
formula: 25/60-frame wait [rdi+0x294]. replace 7B (sub dword [rdi+0x294],1): push rax; mov eax,[ticks60]; sub [rdi+0x294],eax; pop rax; jmp insn+7. flags LIVE (jne uses ZF of the sub); all regs preserved

name: SW2_OpRatioStepDown
formula: replace 8B (subss xmm0,[rip->1.0]): cvtsi2ss xmm2,dword [ticks60]; subss xmm0,xmm2; jmp insn+8 (0x140943A9E). Integer-valued display counter stepping 1 per 60 Hz tick (lin would never hit the target exactly and flicker). xmm2 dead (only calls follow), flags dead (comiss follows)

name: SW2_OpRatioStepUp
formula: replace 8B (addss xmm0,[rip->1.0]): cvtsi2ss xmm2,dword [ticks60]; addss xmm0,xmm2; jmp insn+8 (0x140943A9E). xmm2 dead, flags dead

name: SW2_PollutionFillStep
formula: replace 9B (mulss xmm0,[r14+0x98]): mulss xmm0,[r14+0x98]; mulss xmm0,[e]; jmp insn+9 (addss xmm0,xmm8). per-frame increment s*range scaled by e; flags dead (comiss follows)
